title: Cosmic Witch Sisters
description: Two women with pale skin and intricate glowing spiral tattoos dominate the foreground. The upper woman is bald with elaborate swirling hair extensions, while the lower has long flowing red hair. They are surrounded by a dark surreal nightscape filled with glowing green demonic figures, a large horned shadow silhouette with pink eyes, ruined gothic structures, and a vibrant purple starry sky.
